confidence_notes: FX comes from the RBA page, as found by search: 0.6720 USD per AUD at 4.00 pm on 2026-11-18. Food and drink anchors rest on one aggregated cost-of-living search. Its sources disagreed widely and some were dated, so I chose bounded mid-values. Cocktail and wine were set from the local price relationship to beer, not from direct price data. I did not search for accommodation. Those anchors are holistic estimates for a tourist-heavy border city, and I did not inspect any listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other mid-sized Brazilian tourist cities in the south, such as Curitiba and Florianópolis. Foz do Iguaçu is about 8% cheaper than the Brazilian average in the cost-of-living sources found, but tourist demand near the falls pushes restaurant and hotel prices above local levels.
